At around 11:15pm, the x-ray machine repeatedly rejected a bag. QA inspected and found a rubber screw head with a metal plate from the matrix. Five of six matrix pieces were present; the sixth piece was missing. The line and surrounding areas were checked, but the nut could not be located. A similar nut was tested through the X-ray and was successfully detected.

4 finished pallets completed during the affected timeframe were placed on hold for re-screening through the x-ray again. As a precaution, all remaining pieces from Matrix 6, 7, and 8 were removed.
